story.description: Repo-relative path to the story this verifies. Required because the test-scope edge resolves AC priorities from it; without it there is no declared scope to check and the check degrades to a no-op.

command.description: The test command actually run, verbatim from config.test_command. Recorded so a reviewer can re-run it rather than take the result on trust.

status.description: `not-run` is a distinct answer from `red`: a suite that could not start says nothing about the code, and conflating them would let a missing test command read as a failing build.

tests.description: The tests this change carries. `covers` is what makes the P0/P1 scope check possible at all — without it the edge cannot tell which criteria are tested.

covers.description: Acceptance criterion ids. One test may legitimately cover several.

protected_paths_checked.description: Whether the protected-path check actually ran. False with an empty violations list means nobody looked — which must not read the same as nothing found.
